verdict.rationale: Foreloop's docs say feedback submissions are triaged as real or spam. An intention then starts from each report, and its agent reads the submission, fills in the intention and proposes tasks. That is AI-driven conversion of feedback into a work item, roughly a feature idea. The evidence does not show AI detecting insights or themes across many feedback items, or linking new feedback to existing related ideas rather than starting a new intention per report. Missing for 10: insight or theme detection across feedback, automatic linking of feedback to existing related feature ideas or deduplication, independent or hands-on corroboration.
